title: A clean uptrend, every sensor VALID
why: The one scenario with no caution at all: M15 and M5 both in an uptrend inside their corridors, MCD3 confirming (consolidated up). Both trader types get a LONG with the trend (rules 3 and 3s), status VALID, one confirming reason, and zones whose invalidation sits behind a structure level (basis LEVEL). The bar still forming has another close than the last closed one; the reference price must be the closed one.
